page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance and multi-threaded operations, such as bzip3 decompression and software compilation, consistently achieve average tier results. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads and writes also align with mid-range performance standards.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is suited for workloads that leverage multi-threaded processing without requiring high single-core speeds or local NVMe storage. Appropriate applications include static web serving, database operations, Redis key-value stores, and moderate multi-threaded data processing. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a stable, dedicated resource profile for standard enterprise workloads, though users requiring high single-thread throughput or local disk I/O may face performance bottlenecks.
